_meta.title: Cineforge Flux txt2img (free local, fp8)
_meta.description: FLUX.1-dev fp8 text-to-image — runs FREE on a T4 via ComfyUI (--lowvram). Far better cartoon/character stills than base SDXL. Requires the all-in-one fp8 checkpoint at models/checkpoints/flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors (Comfy-Org repackage). Flux is guidance-distilled: cfg=1.0 + a FluxGuidance node (node 26); negative (node 7) stays empty. Injection map (node_map.json -> flux_txt2img): positive=6, width/height=5, seed/steps=3, filename=9.
